verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs and probe confirm the core prompt-to-app promise: 'turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app' with a managed Postgres DB, typed endpoints, auth, email, and one-click publish, all built via natural-language AI chat interaction. This is well documented across getting-started, integrations, and changelog pages, covering frontend, backend, database, and deployment. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration (e.g., reviews or third-party demos) confirming the generated app actually works end-to-end, since all evidence is vendor-sourced docs and probes.
